569:t_006:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I... don't know what I can do... I don't understand starting the world over anymore, either...)

569:t_007:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I'm not running away... I'm going to fight, alongside everyone in $c...)

569:t_007:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
(And I'll definitely come back... To find out what I can do for this world...)

569:t_008:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「...The distortion in the dimensional boundary... has subsided.」

569:t_008:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「It looks like we've made it back.」

569:t_008:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Everyone in $c is safe, too.」

569:t_008:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Please look at the center of that hole!」

569:t_008:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Please look at the center of that hole!」

569:t_008:5.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Please look at the center of that hole!」

569:t_009:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Are they forcing the dimensional distortion under control...?」

569:t_009:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'm sure those kids... are trying to protect Earth from whatever comes out of there.」

569:t_009:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This should hold off the $$バアル$$ attacks for the time being.」

569:t_009:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Preparations for the counteroffensives in each region are nearly complete. It's time for $$オペレーション・エクリプス$$ to enter its final phase.」

569:t_009:6.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...Brat $$シンジ$$... Did we make it back thanks to you?」

569:t_009:10.en:
$$アスカ$$
「We can't go home when we've still got unfinished business in this world.」

569:t_009:11.en:
$$アスカ$$
「We'll hurry up and crush the Empire. Our own world comes after that.」

569:t_009:13.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I don't know whether this was the right choice...)

569:t_009:14.en:
$$シンジ$$
(But for now, I'll face forward. Just like $$かなめ$$ and $$ニコラ$$ did.)

569:t_100:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
(What can I do...? What do I want to do...?)

569:t_101:0.en:
$$マリ$$
「What do we do, Princess? Now we're back in our world, should we find an opening and blast Puppy from behind?」

569:t_101:1.en:
$$アスカ$$
「We don't have time for that now...! Those aren't ordinary $$アンゲロイ$$s!」

569:t_101:2.en:
$$マリ$$
「Roger that. Then we're still part of $c until we beat them.」

569:t_101:3.en:
$$アスカ$$
(Brat $$シンジ$$... I'll put off settling things with you for now.)

569:t_102:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(This is the world $$シンジ$$ came from...)

569:t_102:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(It looks like... I didn't know anything about $$シンジ$$...)

569:t_103:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Damn it...! I've got to focus on the enemy in front of me now!」

569:t_104:0.en:
$$赤木$$
(I had a vague feeling something had happened, but I never imagined $$シンジ$$'s world... was in such terrible shape...)

569:t_104:1.en:
$$赤木$$
($$シンジ$$... You... were enduring all of this alone...)

569:t_104:2.en:
$$赤木$$
(Hang in there, $$シンジ$$! All I can do now is cheer you on in my heart, but I'll always be there to help you!)

569:t_105:0.en:
$$カレン$$
($$シンジ$$, $$アスカ$$... You didn't talk much about yourselves because your world was like this...)

569:t_105:1.en:
$$カレン$$
(I'm sorry... I... can't do anything...)

569:t_105:2.en:
$$カレン$$
(So I'll fight alongside you...! No matter what happens, you're both precious juniors to me!)

569:t_106:0.en:
$n
(If this transfer happened because $$シンジ$$ wished to come to this world, then what am I...?)

569:t_106:1.en:
$n
(Did my touching $$シンジ$$ trigger the transfer...?)
